heading: Hi, I'm Joel.
paragraphs: I'm a product designer in Seattle who has spent the last 10 years shaping how people experience work—from the tools employees use for everyday HR, personal, and financial tasks, to the systems supporting operations across a global campus. Before that, I designed for an NBA team and built experiences for Fortune 500 clients.
Outside of work, I'm a family-first comic book nerd, smart home enthusiast, options trader, F1 fan, and DIY 4Runner modifier — a mix of obsessions that constantly informs how I think about design.
I'm always looking for the next interesting problem. If something here catches your eye, I'd love to hear from you.
